Class BoardStyler

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.ui.BoardStyler
public class BoardStyler extends Object
Handles the visual styling and coloring of individual Tetris blocks and the board.

This class acts as the "Painter" for the game. It applies fill colors, border strokes, and effects (like Glow or Shadow) to the JavaFX Rectangle nodes.

It supports two distinct visual modes:

  • Normal Mode: Bricks are colored based on their ID (Pastel/Fruit theme).
  • Frozen Mode: All bricks turn cyan/blue with a glowing ice effect (Power-up state).
Author:
Jacob Villegas

    • updateFrozenTheme

      public void updateFrozenTheme(boolean isFrozen, javafx.scene.layout.Region rootPane, javafx.scene.layout.Region gamePanel, javafx.scene.layout.Region gameBoard)
      Toggles the CSS classes on the main game containers to reflect the Frozen state.

      This adds a CSS class (e.g., "frozen-board") to the root pane, allowing the stylesheet to change the background image or border colors globally.

      Parameters:
      isFrozen - true to apply the ice theme; false to revert to normal.
      rootPane - The main window container.
      gamePanel - The specific grid container.
      gameBoard - The background board region.

    • styleRectangle

      public void styleRectangle(javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle rectangle, int colorId, boolean isBackground)
      Applies the correct visual style to a single block (rectangle) in the grid.

      This method handles:

      1. Fill Color: Determines if it should use the brick's specific ID color or the generic "Ice" color.
      2. Stroke/Border: Adds a darker border for depth.
      3. Effects: Adds a glowing DropShadow (Soft gray for normal, bright Cyan for frozen).
      4. Visibility: Hides empty blocks (ID 0) unless they are part of the grid background lines.
      Parameters:
      rectangle - The JavaFX node to style.
      colorId - The integer ID of the brick type (0=Empty, 1=I, 2=J, etc.).
      isBackground - true if this rectangle represents a locked background block; false if it is part of the falling active piece.

    • styleGhost

      public void styleGhost(javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle rectangle)
      Styles the "Ghost" piece (the transparent shadow showing where the block will land).

      The ghost style also adapts to the frozen state:

      • Normal: Gray, semi-transparent.
      • Frozen: Bright Cyan, thicker border, more opaque.
      Parameters:
      rectangle - The ghost block to style.
